note: Flathead NF (Hungry Horse-Glacier View Ranger District), remote near the Canadian border in the Whitefish Range on Rd #114; several trailheads nearby. ACCESS: come in from the west (US 93 north of Whitefish, Graves Creek Rd, then Rd #114); the rough road west from Polebridge is not suitable for RVs. Elev ~4640 ft. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Feb 27, 2026): confirmed 7 sites, no fee, vault toilets, no potable water; added the 16-day limit and the 'access opening date varies' season caveat. Note: district named, approach direction corrected (Graves Creek Rd is the western approach), restated values trimmed.
